messages:
incident-bot: Pager: unusual auth 401 spike on proxy-gateway-usw2 (elevated error rate, 10x baseline)
incident-bot: Severity: P1 - potential credential exposure - paging oncall

alex: i'm on it, pulling proxy logs and recent deploys :mag_right:

maria: any customer 5xx/401 reports yet?

cs-lead: just one support ticket from customer 'Borealis Inc' saying their webhooks failing with 401s, escalated to priority

sre-oncall: checking current deploys — nothing in last 2 hours. hitting the proxy logs now.

alex: minimal traces, but seeing sequences of repeated bearer tokens with different IPs, looks like token replay/fanout:
```
# sample from proxy logs
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z proxy-gateway request_id=abc123 auth_bearer=tok_XX... src_ip=18.205.10.2 status=401
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z proxy-gateway request_id=abc124 auth_bearer=tok_XX... src_ip=3.88.45.9 status=401
```

sec-ops: tagging this as suspected token exfil. please avoid mass revokes until we confirm blast radius. preserve logs and rate-limit suspicious tokens.

jamal: can we apply immediate WAF rule to block the two IP ranges showing the highest traffic? Will throttle while we assess.

sre-oncall: applying temporary IP-based blocklists now (usw2 infra rules). will monitor error rate.

maria: customer impact? cs-lead said 1 ticket but could be broader. alex, can you correlate token IDs to customer ids?

alex: correlating — some tokens map to internal service accounts + 3 customers (Borealis, FinchLabs, AtlasRetail). internal svcacct tokens show far higher attempt rate.

sec-ops: propose plan:
- preserve evidence (don't rotate yet for shared tokens)
- throttle/block offending IPs
- rotate only keys that are confirmed leaked (service accounts first)
- notify affected customers with minimal detail and remediation steps

cs-lead: prepping customer notice template. want to avoid panic; will send once we have confirmed list of rotated keys.

jamal: started KMS key-swap readiness checklist. need owner confirmation for each svcacct. if we rotate, we'll create short-lived tokens and update role bindings.

alex: doing a quick grep across recent CI artifacts for accidental token uploads to public buckets. no matches so far.

sec-ops: i'm running an affinity scan to see if tokens correlate with a single commit/agent. also request: snapshot of the last 24h of proxy metrics and forward to sec-ops channel.

incident-bot: note: runbook 'security/token-exfiltration-v2' recommended steps: preserve -> contain -> rotate -> notify -> postmortem (https://runbooks.internal/token-exfiltration-v2)

maria: suggestion — do a canary rotate for one internal service account first, confirm no downstream outage, then escalate to customer keys.

sre-oncall: can we bind a fallback route for webhooks to reduce customer impact while tokens being rotated? might need temporary API key allowlist for Borealis.

sec-ops: approve canary rotate for svc-acct 'ingest-worker-1'. alex, coordinate and report results within 10m.

alex: starting canary rotate for ingest-worker-1 now: generating new key, updating staging pool, hitting target pods to roll.

(1m later)
alex: canary rotate succeeded, ingest-worker-1 upstream passed smoke checks. no auth failures observed for that service.

sec-ops: good. proceed with scoped rotations: internal svcaccts first, then customer tokens that map to suspicious token IDs. do not broadcast details externally yet.

cs-lead: drafted message for Borealis: short, factual, steps to rotate their webhook secret, timeframe, contact for questions. will hold until we finalize rotated list.

jamal: preparing automated rotation script snippet to create new keys and stash into vault. sample:
```
aws kms rotate-key --key-id alias/ingest-worker-1 --region us-west-2
vault write secret/data/ingest-worker-1 value=@newkey
```

maria: monitoring shows 60% drop in auth 401 rate after IP blocks and canary rotate. still above baseline but trending down.

sec-ops: one more ask — capture memory heap of proxy instance that logged earliest suspicious token to check for debug logs with tokens in memory. tag it as forensic evidence.

alex: grabbing heap and packing / preserving. will upload to secure evidence bucket (access: sec-ops only).

cs-lead: if we rotate customer keys, we need to coordinate maintenance window and provide instruction. prefer rolling secret rotation with minimal downtime.

sre-oncall: setting a short-lived maintenance window for today +30m for key swaps we control. posting to status page if customers impacted.

incident-bot: escalation note: legal-privilege check recommended before wide disclosure. Filing ticket to legal.

sec-ops: agreed. legal loop-in done. they want list of affected tenants and timelines.

maria: live numbers — affected tenants currently 3, impacted webhook success rate down 40% for those tenants.

jamal: ready to rotate keys for FinchLabs and AtlasRetail once we confirm customer contact windows. requesting cs-lead to confirm they'll accept immediate rotation and assist with secret roll.

cs-lead: contacting Borealis and FinchLabs now. asking for 1hr window for secret swap, offering support steps.

(10m later)
cs-lead: Borealis accepted immediate rotation and asked for support during regen. FinchLabs requested 30m delay. AtlasRetail hasn't responded yet.

sec-ops: proceed: rotate internal svcaccts now (done), rotate Borealis and FinchLabs when their window opens, preserve AtlasRetail until they respond.

maria: error rate down to 20% above baseline. no sign of new IP ranges yet.

alex: forensic artifacts uploaded, IP lists and suspicious token candidates attached. will prepare a concise post-incident timeline.

sec-ops: great work. temp mitigation applied, targeted rotations planned, customer comms queued, legal engaged. keep this channel for live updates only.

sre-oncall: closing pager for now but staying on watch for 2 hours. tagging incident with 'auth-exfil-suspected' and creating incident tracker.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-18-3012345670 created. Follow runbook and update incident tracker.

alex: next steps: finalize list of rotated keys, upload rotation audit logs, and prep postmortem draft.

cs-lead: will send customer notices after each rotation completes. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
